page.layout: Running head at top centre, with page number at top left. Two engraved coin medallions side by side near the top, each with a legend round its edge. Below them, one column of text in two paragraphs. A printer's ornament sits low on the page, centre right. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: HERODES, non Zenobia matre, sed priore Odenati u-xore genitus, cum patre accepit Imperiū, homo omnium deli-catissimus, ac prorsus Orientalis, & græcæ luxuriæ, cui erant fi-gillata tentoria, & aurati papiliones, & omnia Persica. Denique ingenio eius usus Odenatus, regias Saporis cōcubinas, & quas-cunq; gemmas ac diuitias cepit, huic filio suo Herodi tradidit paterna motus indulgentia. Oderat illum Zenobia nouercali animo, quare cōmendabiliorem eum patri fecerat. Consulito Trebellium Pollionem.

MÆONIVS Odenati consobrinus inuidia extimulatus Imperatorem optimum, eundémque consobrinum suum interemit, cùm ei nihil aliud obiiceretur, præter filij Herodis delicias. Dicitur autem primùm cum Zenobia conspirasse, quæ ferre non poterat ut priuignus suus Herodes princeps diceretur, atque autoritate præiret eius filios, Herennianum & Timo-laum. Hic Ipurcissimus[?] fuit, quare Imperator appellatus per errorē, breui à militibus pro suæ luxuriæ meritis interemptus est. Videto ut supra.

page.notes: Two engraved coin medallions at the top, not text. Left coin: bust of a helmeted man facing right, legend "AVG." on the left and "T. ERODES" on the right. Right coin: bust of a bearded man in a broad-brimmed helmet facing right, legend "IMPER" on the left and "T. MAEONIVS" on the right. The legends are part of the engraving; they are described here, not transcribed as text. The printer's ornament at the bottom is a decorative block, not text. "Ipurcissimus" is uncertain: the first letter may be S, but it reads as I in the scan.
